minimum_evidence.name: owner_or_issuer_identity
minimum_evidence.must_be: independently attributable legal, organizational, project, or maintainer identity with a verifiable authentication reference

minimum_evidence.name: authoritative_relationship
minimum_evidence.must_be: evidence that the identity owns, issues, maintains, or is delegated authority over the exact source artifact and object

minimum_evidence.name: authorized_version_scope
minimum_evidence.must_be: explicit immutable release/version/commit/tree scope; mutable-only branches, URLs, or timestamps are insufficient

minimum_evidence.name: canonical_semantics_authority
minimum_evidence.must_be: explicit authority to designate the canonical intrinsic field semantics, schema identity, and exact pointer for the target

minimum_evidence.name: immutable_authorization_record
minimum_evidence.must_be: content-addressed or cryptographically signed authorization record with a recomputable hash/reference

minimum_evidence.name: revocation_and_supersession
minimum_evidence.must_be: effective status, revocation method, supersession lineage, and conflict check covering the authorization and source version

minimum_evidence.name: independent_verifier
minimum_evidence.must_be: a verifier identity independent of the owner/issuer that can recompute the authorization chain and artifact binding

minimum_evidence.name: target_scope_binding
minimum_evidence.must_be: exact first-tranche target identity and governance scope binding; multiple owner-specific records are allowed
